nodes.label: Clean Architecture Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Separates Domain (pure Kotlin), Data (Room/Retrofit), and Presentation (MVVM) layers.

nodes.label: Kotlin Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Progressive migration from Java 11 / Realm to Kotlin, Coroutines, Flow, Room, and Hilt.

nodes.label: Room Database Migration
nodes.rationale: Replaces MongoDB Realm Java EOL with Jetpack Room SQLite.

nodes.label: Hilt Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Provides standard Android Dagger-based DI, eliminating manual instantiation.

nodes.label: Unidirectional Data Flow & StateFlow
nodes.rationale: Uses sealed interface UiState and StateFlow in ViewModels with lifecycle-aware collection.

nodes.label: Nutritional Deficiency Diagnosis
nodes.rationale: Diagnoses nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and magnesium deficiencies in corn, beans, and sorghum.

nodes.label: AI Fertilization Recommendation System
nodes.rationale: Generates fertilization plans based on ML diagnosis using AI when internet is available.

nodes.label: ML Deficiency Classes & Labels
nodes.rationale: Classification targets for TFLite model covering bean, corn, sorghum with N, P, K, Mg deficiencies and healthy state.
